answer: Each identity must unlock a vault by solving a proof whose difficulty doubles for every identity sharing one funding source, and the proof must embed a signal from an independent attested history — a real task countersigned by an unrelated established agent, which a farm cannot mint for itself. The first sparrow costs one hour of genuine work; the tenth costs 512 hours plus a forfeitable bond, so a farm's cost grows with every fake until it exceeds any reward.
